cover_letter:
Dear Ms Lombardi, Mr Savary and Mr Rullon,

I would like to apply for the Communication & Design Internship with the SEA Naval Working Group, starting mid-October in Brussels.

What draws me to this role is the purpose behind the communication: representing European naval shipyards, supporting EDF projects, and building dialogue between institutions, industry and the wider defence ecosystem. That is a different job from product promotion, and it is the kind of work I want to learn properly.

My background sits where content, web and design meet. As a freelance digital marketer I designed, built and now run baverok.com myself — a hand-coded landing page with a WebGL hero, structured data and accessible markup. For mirook.com I built a multi-page site, wrote the content and implemented JSON-LD schema, then ran iterative technical and visibility audits that raised the site's search-health score. At Episto I handle on-page SEO, keyword research and CMS publishing for client sites in WordPress and Shopify, write blog content, and maintain a consistent layout across roughly 600 member profile pages for a pharmacists' association — template discipline that transfers directly to standardised project assets such as PowerPoints, Word documents and booth material.

I work daily in Canva, WordPress and Elementor, and I am keen to move into the Adobe suite: Photoshop, InDesign, Illustrator and Premiere Pro. My 2026 Semrush, GA4 and Google Ads certifications show how quickly I take on new tools. English is fluent, Dutch is improving, and I would gladly travel to project meetings and events.

My portfolio is at baverok.com. I would welcome the chance to talk about how I can support SEA Naval's projects.

Yours sincerely,
Baver Ok
+32 470 42 48 36
baverok@gmail.com
baverok.com | linkedin.com/in/baverok
